items.subject: Intro to Louis Follet at NVIDIA?
items.body:
Hi Dirk,

You published with me on "Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits" (2017). Would you be comfortable introducing me to Louis Follet, who lists NVIDIA and MIT affiliations as of 2026-11-18? A cached query found 6 matching NVIDIA papers since 2026-08-25, prompting this note. Fine to decline.

Nicholas

Note you can forward:
Louis, I'm Nicholas Harris, a founder at Lightmatter, and I co-authored "Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits" (2017). NVIDIA has 6 matching photonic or optical papers since 2026-08-25, and your publication lists NVIDIA and MIT affiliations as of 2026-11-18, so might this be relevant to you?
